SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM articles a
INNER JOIN article_tags at ON a.id = at.article_id AND at.deleted = 0
WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1
AND (a.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.summary ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.content ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND a.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND at.tag_id IN
#{tagId}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.views, a.likes, a.favorites, a.comments_count, a.is_top, a.is_recommend, a.status, a.published_time, a.create_time, u.username AS author_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.name AS category_name FROM articles a INNER JOIN article_likes al ON a.id = al.article_id LEFT JOIN users u ON a.create_by = u.id LEFT JOIN categories c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE al.create_by = #{userId} AND al.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY al.create_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(a.id) FROM articles a INNER JOIN article_likes al ON a.id = al.article_id WHERE al.create_by = #{userId} AND al.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND a.deleted = 0
